pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark, multi-sided polygons exhibiting extreme edge angularity and sharp, micro-serrated pixel gradients. Individual patches show a high degree of complexity with deeply incised margins rather than smooth curves.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of thin, cream-colored pathways separating the dark patches. The network features high node density with predominantly tri-radial intersections and uniform pixel width across the upper neck and torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette of dark hair filaments against the out-of-focus background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Visible areas of greenish-yellow textural disruption on the lower posterior flank, and a localized circular light-colored anomaly within a dark patch on the mid-neck.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, distinct white punctate mark within a dark patch on the mid-upper neck, suggesting a localized area of depigmentation or physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme 'shattered' or 'leaf-like' appearance of the patch edges is the most distinct visual marker present.
